name: The Timber-Gate Tollhouse
flavor: Storm the fortified river-weir where Captain Rook's mercenaries have barricaded Azure's vital northern trade route.

phases.narration: You ride north from Azure under a canopy of autumn river-oaks, their russet leaves floating down into the brackish shallows of the Cinnamere. Ahead, the trade road turns to corduroy log tracks, where mercenary scouts and hunting hawks watch the tree-line from rope bridges slung through the branches.

You break through the tree-line onto the Timber-Gate Causeway. Ahead, the massive oak logging weir is choked with iron-spiked timber chevaux-de-frise, boiling cauldrons of black pitch, and heavy winch-arbalests aimed down the narrow bridge approach.

You kick open the splintered doors of the stone-and-timber tollhouse. Inside, Captain Rook's trusted lieutenant, Commander Vorn, stands surrounded by savage river-hounds and executioner veterans, iron halberd raised to crush any who threaten the blockade.
